title: A tier's Customers tab lists its customers with their channels
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Open customer A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens with Pricing and Customers tabs.

Step 3:

  • The tab lists customer A with both channels and customer B with work orders.
  • Customer C is not listed (it is on Default for both channels).

Step 4:

  • Customer A's row shows its name and channels.
  • The row offers no actions menu.
